note: Session 9: A) SSE streaming added end-to-end — humanize_answer_stream() in intent_extractor.py, stream_agent_message() in agent_service.py, /api/agent/stream endpoint in agent_api.py, sendAgentMessage() rewritten in chat_v2.js to use fetch+ReadableStream typewriter effect; B) wants_first fix — 'first bus after 5pm' no longer returns first-of-day; explicit am/pm suppresses wants_first; C) route discovery — routes_serving_destination() GTFS query added to schedule_service.py; 'What routes go to UF?' now answered with buttons; 145 tests all green.

vision.statement: An AI-powered transit assistant for Gainesville RTS riders that understands plain-language questions and guides the customer to the right answer — whether that's a real-time ETA or a scheduled departure time.
vision.cx_journey: Customer arrives at the assistant and types a question in plain language (e.g. 'When does the next 75 leave Butler Plaza?'). The assistant leads the interaction — asking clarifying questions when needed — until it can deliver the specific ETA or schedule information the rider needs.
vision.wizard_strategy: The Trip Wizard is the conversation flow prototype. It makes the decision tree explicit (intent → route → stop → direction → result) in a structured UI so the paths can be validated. Once proven, the same guided logic is translated into the chat assistant's prompting — the AI replicates the wizard's flow in natural language instead of button clicks.
vision.end_state: A single assistant interface where any RTS rider can ask a transit question in plain English (or Spanish) and get a reliable, accurate answer without needing to know stop IDs, route numbers, or schedules.

summary.goal: Deliver a stable Gainesville RTS backend with realtime bus info, schedule support, and a user-facing web assistant/dashboard.

tasks.details: schedule_service.parse_time now maps 'morning'→06:00, 'afternoon'→12:00, 'evening'→17:00 (previously fell back to current clock time). agent_service now carries date/time context from history when user replies with just a stop ID (e.g. clicking a disambiguation button), so 'tomorrow morning' survives the button-click turn.

Dashboard improved with vision panel, area grouping, and nav links.

tasks.title: Reliability and data persistence improvements
tasks.details: Analytics log migrated from ephemeral JSON-lines file to SQLite (survives Render redeploys). webqa.py now has go-rts.com as fallback and only locks the index when pages actually cached. Session timeout extended from 5 to 30 minutes. CORS reads from CORS_ORIGINS env var.

tasks.details: Done in Session 7. See completed-agent-split entry.

tasks.title: Replace keyword overlap in webqa.py with OpenAI embeddings
tasks.details: Current token-overlap scoring misses synonyms and context. Replace with text-embedding-3-small vector similarity search. Data is small enough to embed entirely in memory on startup.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for parse_date, parse_time, and intent extraction

tasks.title: Fuzzy stop name resolution in agent (fix 'santa fe' type queries)
tasks.details: Fixed 4 root causes: is_transit_keywords now catches 'next'/'when'/'leaving'/'depart'; transit gate also passes if message has a route number; prefer_schedule trigger fires on stop_name_hint/origin_hint; _gtfs_resolve_stop_name() added for LIKE+fuzzy_lookup scoped to route. Also: parse_time now handles 'morning'→06:00, 'afternoon'→12:00, 'evening'→17:00; history date/time context preserved when user clicks a stop button.

tasks.title: Fix session fragmentation across Gunicorn workers
tasks.details: Resolved via --workers 1 --timeout 120 in render.yaml. Single worker keeps in-memory SessionManager consistent; 120s timeout prevents Gunicorn killing slow LLM responses.

tasks.title: Fix chat triple greeting, parse_time priority, and time-only follow-up fallback
tasks.details: Three bugs fixed: (1) chat_v2.js now strips stale greeting messages from localStorage on load and always shows a single fresh greeting — no more accumulation across sessions; (2) schedule_service.parse_time now checks explicit am/pm times (e.g. 7am) before vague time-of-day words (morning/afternoon/evening) so 'after 7am?' returns 07:00 not 06:00; (3) agent_service now merges full user-message history (ctx) for time-only follow-up messages so 'after 7am?' carries route/bus context forward and passes the transit gate.

tasks.title: Add rate limiting to /api/agent to prevent API cost abuse
tasks.details: Flask-Limiter added (requirements.txt). utils/limiter.py holds shared instance. limiter.init_app(app) called in app factory. /api/agent decorated with @limiter.limit('30 per hour') (configurable via RATE_LIMIT env var). Returns 429 on breach.

tasks.title: Set CORS_ORIGINS env var in Render to restrict to production domain
tasks.details: Done in Session 7. CORS_ORIGINS=https://rts-backend-7ru5.onrender.com added to render.yaml.

tasks.title: Fix webqa.py hardcoded gpt-4o-mini (ignores OPENAI_MODEL env var)
tasks.details: webqa.py answer() now builds its OpenAI client with OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY from env, matching the agent_service pattern. OPENAI_MODEL already read from env at module level.

tasks.title: Add retry with exponential backoff for OpenAI API calls
tasks.details: Used OpenAI SDK's built-in max_retries=3 and timeout=30 in _openai_client(). SDK retries on 429 RateLimit and 5xx with exponential backoff (~1s/2s/4s). Both params configurable via OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES and OPENAI_TIMEOUT env vars.

tasks.title: Reduce OpenAI calls from up to 4 down to 1-2 per agent request
tasks.details: Removed two wasted LLM calls: (1) history_summary = _history_summary_for_llm(history) was computed in try_transit_answer but never used (code switched to llm_extract_intent_hybrid which takes raw history); (2) build_direction_prompt's LLM rewrite replaced with deterministic template that includes route/stop context. Per-request calls: 1 (intent extraction only) to 2 (if direction needed for multi-direction routes). humanize_answer already off by default.

Fixed stop-context loss bug via ctx-strip approach: full user history stripped of old 'after TIME' patterns, preserving route AND stop name from all prior turns. 145 tests all green.
